title: Derived table SQL that reads ${orders.SQL_TABLE_NAME} reads the orders table
rule: A ${view.SQL_TABLE_NAME} reference in derived table SQL reads the table of the referenced view.

citations.quote: ${view_name.SQL_TABLE_NAME} references another view or derived table.
In addition to referencing normal database tables, you can also reference LookML views or derived tables in sql.

rationale: order_facts.view.lkml comes before orders.view.lkml in path order, so a tool that resolves references while reading files in that order has not seen orders when it reads order_facts. The reference names a view of the model, wherever that view is defined.
